Container.Name: costcoorange
Container.Overview: CostcoOrange backend: syncs the family's Costco receipts and online orders and serves the Android app. Reached through Nginx Proxy Manager at costco.eristhewerd.com (host costcoorange, port 8747), so no port is published. Put it on the same Docker network as NPM.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database with the full purchase history. Back this up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the server runs as (Unraid nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the server runs as (Unraid users)

Config.Name: Sync interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to pull new receipts from Costco
